content: मीलित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [मील्-क्त] .²1 Shut, closed. .²2 Twinkled. .²3 Half-opened, unblown. .²4 Vanished, disappeared. .²5 Assembled, gathered (for मिलित). .{@-तम्@} (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) A figure of speech in which the difference or distinction between two objects is shown to be completely obscured on account of their similarity, whether natural or artificial, in some respects; it is thus defined by Mammaṭa:-- समेन लक्ष्मणा वस्तु वस्तुना यन्निगूह्यते . निजेनागन्तुना वापि तन्मीलितमिति स्मृतम् .. <ls>K. P. 10</ls>.
